What are VLESS, Hysteria 2 and Tor?
VLESS and Hysteria 2 are connection protocols. Imported links already contain their parameters. Tor uses a separate network and may need a bridge; its first connection can take longer.

Appearance
Full tunnel sends traffic through the VPN. Smart routing applies exceptions, including your chosen region. App rules choose which apps use the tunnel.
DNS finds the address of a website. If the tunnel connects but sites fail to open, use connection diagnostics before changing advanced options.
Choose a theme and tune visual effects. On a slower device, turn off animations, the decorative background or glass highlights.
